title: Validation-error re-render discards the rejected answer: the inline error says 'Check it and try again' but the input is gone
location: form_handler.gleam:321-324 + form_handler.gleam:214 (error re-render prefill source) ↔ form_question_pages.gleam:397/414
detail: On a failed no-JS POST the re-render prefills from the last SAVED draft (the failed POST never persisted), so the rejected input (8-digit amount, malformed month, pasted >200 chars) is not shown under 'Check it and try again' - the referee retypes from scratch.
recommended_fix: On validation error, render prefill as the submitted raw fields (draft values underneath), so the rejected answer survives the inline error re-render.
